claim.claim-text: 1. A method for centrally locating a vehicle (100) on a roadway (104), said method comprising:
2. The method according to claim 1, wherein the tire track identification comprises using a thermal imaging sensor assembly (106) disposed on the vehicle (100).
3. The method according to claim 2, wherein the thermal imaging sensor assembly comprises at least one forward-looking infra-red imaging sensor (106) mounted to the vehicle (100).
4. The method according to claim 3 wherein the at least one infra-red sensor (106) comprises:

a left infra-red sensor (106L) mounted on the left side of the vehicle (100) for thermal imaging tire tracks (126) the left side of the vehicle; and a right infra-red sensor (106R) mounted on the right side of the vehicle (100) for thermal imaging tire tracks (126) on the right side of the vehicle.

5. The method according to any one of the claims 3 or 4, wherein the step of identifying the tire tracks (126) of the previous vehicle's travel (126) on the roadway (104) using thermal imaging comprises identifying residual tire heat from the tire tracks (126).

6. The method according to claim 1, wherein the tire track identification comprises identifying a thermal difference between a first thermal signature on a portion of the roadway traversed by the previous vehicle's tires and a second thermal signature representative of a portion of the roadway not traversed by the previous vehicle's tires.
7. The method according to claim 1, further comprising the step of adjusting the vehicle's position based on the identified adjustment using the vehicle's guidance system (114).

8. The method according to claim 7, wherein the adjustment of the vehicle's position comprises at least one of (i) providing input to the vehicle's steering system (116); (ii) activating the vehicle's braking system (118); and (iii) activating the vehicle's propulsion system (120).

9. The method according to claim 1, further comprising the step of displaying the identified adjustment on at least one of a heads-up display and a see-through OLED panel (122), either affixed to the interior of a windshield of the vehicle or sandwiched between layers of said windshield, associated with the vehicle (100).
